content.text:
| Finding ID | Severity | Item | Flaw Analysis | Concrete Code/Rule Fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| F-01 | CRITICAL | [PayrollCalculator.java:128] Holiday-night (+60%) | Holiday 35% + night 25% = 60% is satisfied only because nightAllowance is not zeroed. This is not asserted or tested. | Add an explicit test: holiday+night yields 160% total. Keep the night allowance un-suppressed for holiday work. |
| F-02 | CRITICAL | [PayrollService.java:215; PayrollCalculator.java:123-129] Night-overtime (+50%) | nightOvertimeAllowance is computed but excluded from totalPay. It is also never summed or persisted at service level (L160-163 omit it). Totals are right only through 25%+25% additive composition, and the audit-detail field is dead and misleading. | Remove the field, or assert in-code that nightAllowance+overtimeAllowance covers 50%. Persist or drop it consistently. |
| F-03 | HIGH | [PayrollService.java:132-134] Night-overtime minutes | Uses min(overtime, night), which assumes full overlap. A night shift 22:00-05:00 followed by day overtime misattributes overlap. Only the dead field is affected, but the same assumption would corrupt any future use. | Compute the overlap from actual intervals in AttendanceTimeCalculator, not from min(). |
| F-04 | HIGH | [PayrollCalculator.java:108,115,118,100] Rounding | HALF_UP is applied per day per component. Art. 37 / the Ministry circular allow rounding 50 sen down / 50 sen and above up only on the monthly sum of allowances. Daily rounding accumulates drift across ~25 days. | Accumulate unrounded BigDecimal values per month and round once per component at month level. |
| F-05 | HIGH | [PayrollService.java:186-213] 60h+ overtime | The extra 25% is computed by iterating attendances. Sort order is not guaranteed to be chronological because the findCompletedAttendances order is unverified. Also, it adds to overtimeAllowance only, so the monthly rounding differs from the daily path. | Sort by workDate and clockIn before the loop. Persist the over-60 amount separately. |
| F-06 | HIGH | [PayrollService.java:97-115] Statutory 8h/day overtime | Overtime is overwritten from the 8h/day rule only. The weekly 40h statutory rule is ignored, so weekly overtime is unpaid. It also overwrites the calculator's overtime for single shifts. | Add a weekly 40h accumulation after daily overtime, and avoid double-counting. |
| F-07 | HIGH | [PayrollService.java:107-110] Split-shift overtime | Overtime for a day is assigned per record, but later holiday handling zeroes overtime for the whole record. Overtime minutes are still added to totalOvertimeMinutes (L159) and the over-60 loop (L190-212). A holiday record therefore still counts toward the 60h threshold and adds 25% extra pay. | Skip holiday attendances in the over-60 accumulation. Exclude them from totalOvertimeMinutes. |
| F-08 | HIGH | [PayrollService.java:186-213 vs :357] Over-60 night | The comment claims 175% for night overtime above 60h, but the extra is always 25%, which is correct. The per-day wage lookup is repeated with a DB call per attendance (N+1) and is inconsistent with the first loop if the data changes mid-transaction. | Cache the wage per date in a Map. |
| F-09 | MEDIUM | [PayrollService.java:119,150,194] N+1 queries | A DB call per attendance for wage and transport, inside a loop, at 2-3 queries per row. | Batch-fetch wages and transport fees for the period. |
| F-10 | MEDIUM | [PayrollService.java:117-119] Mid-month wage change | appliedHourlyWage is null when wages differ, with no audit trail. The detail response (L343) exposes a null wage. | Persist a wage-change flag, or per-day wage only (already stored in the details). Null-guard in the DTO. |
| F-11 | MEDIUM | [PayrollService.java:120-129] Dead check | The L127 check (hourlyWage <= 0) is unreachable after L120. | Remove it. |
| F-12 | HIGH | [PayrollService.java:60-63, 281-287] Overwrite guard | Guard is correct for CONFIRMED/PAID. But confirmPayroll calls calculatePayrollForStaff, which re-locks and re-reads. This is safe in a single transaction, but L61 will throw if status is anything other than DRAFT, including a null status on legacy rows. | Make the null-status case explicit. |
| F-13 | HIGH | [PayrollService.java:65-69] Unresolved check vs. closure | countUnresolvedAttendance blocks the whole calculation for one stuck record. There is no per-staff skip in the bulk calculateMonthlyPayroll (L49-51): one exception aborts and rolls back all staff. | Catch per staff, collect failures, and report them. |
| F-14 | HIGH | [PayrollService.java:269-272] Confirm timing | Uses LocalDate.now() with JST, but AttendanceService uses LocalDateTime.now() (system default zone) at L34, L363. Zone mismatch near midnight can misassign workDate. | Inject a Clock with Asia/Tokyo everywhere. |
| F-15 | HIGH | [PayrollService.java:291-296] Confirm race | Recalculation happens inside confirm, but a mismatch throws after upsertPayroll has already rewritten the DRAFT. The transaction rolls back, so this is consistent. However the manager is never shown the new amount. | Return the recalculated amount in the exception. |
| F-16 | MEDIUM | [PayrollService.java:355] Summary omits holiday allowance | PayrollSummary does not set holidayAllowance, so the detail view cannot reconcile to grossPay (L354). Daily detail omits it too (L361-372). | Set the holiday allowance in the summary and the daily detail. |
| F-17 | HIGH | [AttendanceService.java:34,363] Clock | LocalDateTime.now() uses the JVM default zone, which is untestable and breaks the night-window (22:00-05:00) classification if the server is UTC. | Inject Clock(Asia/Tokyo). |
| F-18 | HIGH | [AttendanceService.java:297,319] Break reconciliation | Math.max(totalBreakMin, calc.totalBreakMinutes()) silently picks the larger break, which can reduce paid minutes versus the approved request. | Use the calculator result only, or reject the mismatch. |
| F-19 | HIGH | [AttendanceService.java:344-401] forceClose | reviewerId and adminReason are never used: no ownership check and no audit record. A caller can force-close another store's attendance. | Apply the owner/store check from reviewModification (L246-249). Persist the reason. |
| F-20 | HIGH | [AttendanceService.java:344-401] forceClose after payroll confirm | There is no isPayrollConfirmedForDate check, so a force-close can alter minutes in a confirmed period. | Add the confirmed-period guard. |
| F-21 | MEDIUM | [AttendanceService.java:60-70] Clock-in overnight | Clock-in is not blocked when the previous day's overnight shift is unresolved. The workDate is assigned to the clock-in date only. Cross-midnight work spanning a closed period is mis-bucketed. | Define the workDate rule explicitly. |
| F-22 | MEDIUM | [AttendanceService.java:106] Break duration | toMinutes truncates seconds, so repeated short breaks lose time. | Use the calculator's intervals. |
| F-23 | MEDIUM | [ShiftService.java:121-129] Break rule | Art. 34 requires 45 min when work exceeds 6h. The code uses gross minutes <= 525 for 45 min, but gross of 480 with a 45-minute break is fine. Gross over 480 net requires 60. 525 gross minus 45 = 480 net passes, but 526 gross minus 45 = 481 net, which is over 8h and does require 60, so the threshold is correct. However, a break is deducted from a gross of exactly 361 to give net 316, which is lawful. | No fix needed. |
| F-24 | LOW | [PayrollCalculator.java:135-137] intValueExact | Throws ArithmeticException on overflow without a domain message. | Wrap it with a descriptive exception. |
| F-25 | MEDIUM | [PayrollCalculator.java:95-97] Validation | Validation does not enforce nightOvertimeMinutes <= min(night, overtime). Invalid input is accepted silently. | Validate it. |

{"id":"F-06","loc":"PayrollService.java:97-115","assertion":"No weekly 40h overtime","scenario":"Staff works 5 x 9h... weekly excess beyond daily 8h not captured when days under 8h but week over 40h"},
{"id":"F-07","loc":"PayrollService.java:159,190-212","assertion":"Holiday overtime counted toward 60h threshold","scenario":"Holiday record keeps overtimeMinutes in entity and adds extra 25% beyond 60h cumulative"},

{"id":"F-20","loc":"AttendanceService.java:344-401","assertion":"forceClose ignores confirmed payroll","scenario":"Force-closing alters minutes after payroll CONFIRMED, diverging from stored payroll"}
]

VERDICT: FAIL
